questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A passenger standing in a bus falls backward when the bus suddenly starts moving. This is due to:
questions.explanation: The lower body moves with the bus but the upper body tends to stay at rest, so the person leans back. When a moving bus brakes suddenly, inertia of motion throws him forward instead.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 4: Laws of Motion

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: With a rise in temperature, the viscosity of a liquid and that of a gas respectively:
questions.explanation: In a liquid, heating weakens the intermolecular attraction so it flows more easily, while in a gas viscosity comes from molecular collisions, which become more frequent and vigorous on heating.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 9: Mechanical Properties of Fluids

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The speed of electromagnetic waves in free space is given by:
questions.explanation: Maxwell found this combination of two purely electrical and magnetic constants equals 3 × 10⁸ m/s, which matched the measured speed of light and showed light itself is an electromagnetic wave.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The oxidation state of oxygen in the compound OF₂ is:
questions.explanation: Fluorine is the most electronegative element and is always -1, so oxygen must be +2 here. This is the one common compound where oxygen shows a positive oxidation state.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The number of structural isomers possible for the alkane C₅H₁₂ is:
questions.explanation: They are n-pentane, isopentane (2-methylbutane) and neopentane (2,2-dimethylpropane). More branching lowers the boiling point, so neopentane boils lowest.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The effective atomic number (EAN) of the central metal atom in [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻ is:
questions.explanation: EAN = atomic number - oxidation state + 2 × coordination number = 26 - 2 + 12 = 36, the krypton configuration, which is why this complex is so stable.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Red tides in the sea, which can kill large numbers of fish, are caused by the rapid multiplication of:
questions.explanation: These photosynthetic protists bloom so densely that the water turns red, and the toxins they release kill fish and other marine animals.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Griffith's experiment with Streptococcus pneumoniae, in which heat killed S strain bacteria turned living R strain bacteria virulent, demonstrated:
options: That DNA is made of nucleotides
The phenomenon of transformation, in which a transforming principle passes between cells
That proteins are the genetic material
questions.explanation: Griffith could not say what the transforming principle was. Avery, MacLeod and McCarty later showed by enzyme digestion that it was DNA and not protein.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 5: Molecular Basis of Inheritance

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: In the final step of blood clotting, the enzyme thrombin converts:
options: Soluble fibrinogen into insoluble fibrin threads
questions.explanation: The mesh of fibrin threads traps blood cells and forms the clot. Calcium ions are needed at several steps of this cascade, which is why citrate stops stored blood from clotting.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 15: Body Fluids and Circulation

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Elephantiasis, or lymphatic filariasis, is caused by:
options: Wuchereria bancrofti, a filarial worm spread by mosquitoes
questions.explanation: The worms live in the lymphatic vessels and block them, so fluid collects and the limb swells grossly. Entamoeba causes amoebiasis and Trichophyton ringworm.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 7: Human Health and Disease
